title: Recovering Temporal and Geographic Signals from Language Model Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2609.05721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding whether language-model embeddings encode structured real-world information is important for both representation analysis and information retrieval. We study this question for temporal and geographic signals using a simple projection-based method that operates directly on output embeddings. Given a small set of seed examples, the method defines an axis in embedding space and ranks texts or entities by their projection onto that axis. Our approach is fully black-box and model-agnostic: it requires only embeddings, without access to model weights, internal activations, auxiliary probes, or additional training. This makes it applicable to modern embedding models available only through APIs and provides a lightweight way to analyze whether temporal and spatial dimensions are present in their representation spaces. translated_title: 从语言模型嵌入中恢复时间与地理信号
translated_abstract: 理解语言模型嵌入是否编码了结构化的现实世界信息，对于表示分析和信息检索都具有重要意义。我们利用一种直接作用于输出嵌入的简单投影方法来研究时间和地理信号这一这个问题。给定一小组种子样本，该方法在嵌入空间中定义一个轴，并根据文本或实体在该轴上的投影对其进行排序。我们的方法完全是黑盒且模型无关的：它只需要嵌入本身，无需访问模型权重、内部激活、辅助探测手段或额外训练。这使得该方法适用于只能通过API访问的现代嵌入模型，并提供了一种轻量级的方式来分析其表示空间中是否存在时间和空间维度。我们将该方法应用于时间和地理数据集，发现嵌入投影能够恢复有意义的时序……
tldr: 该论文提出一种完全黑盒、无需训练和模型权重的投影方法，仅凭少量种子样本即可从语言模型输出嵌入中恢复时间与地理信号，适用于仅能通过API访问的嵌入模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fully black-box, training-free projection method that recovers temporal and geographic signals from language model output embeddings using only a few seed examples, making it applicable to API-only embedding models.
